compatibility_policy.exact_definition: Offered product or variant matches the identified product reference. This does not certify installation, electrical compatibility, physical fidelity or crash-damage response.
compatibility_policy.analogue_definition: Economic calibration reference only. Do not silently alter the simulated aircraft's mass, hardware, performance, protocol or features.
required_before_production_import: Resolve purchase-bundle overlap and sold quantity.
Keep source prices separate from game allowances and labor-duration policy.

field_semantics.price_minor: Integer advertised price for the stated sold unit, in currency minor units; USD/EUR/AUD use 100 minor units per currency unit.
field_semantics.unit_and_quantity: A set or pair is one sold package. contained_unit_count is null where exact constituent count is unknown.
field_semantics.package_includes: Only explicitly retained contents are listed, except where a caution labels an inference. A null quantity is unknown.
field_semantics.package_excludes: Only verified exclusions are listed. An empty array means no exclusion was verified, not that everything is included.
field_semantics.package_details_complete: False means this is not an exhaustive package bill of materials.
field_semantics.availability: Observed vendor status, not a promise of fulfillment and not a zero-value rule.
field_semantics.exact_vs_analogue: Evidence-to-authored-product relation; never a compatibility certification.
field_semantics.evidence_confidence: Qualitative confidence in product/listing evidence; not a statistical crash-damage confidence interval.
